home.title: Hi, I'm $t(site.displayName)
home.description:
I'm a software engineering master's student who loves open source and sharing what I build.
I'm working to grow into an engineer who ships products with genuinely better user experiences.
I'm especially interested in AI infrastructure across the stack and in agent-based systems, and I'm actively learning and exploring both.

Thank you for visiting. I hope you might become my teacher and my friend.
This site is still under construction. Some content may be incomplete or incorrect, and I appreciate your understanding.

contactDialog.title: Contact Details
contactDialog.description: You can reach me through the following public channels:
contactDialog.privacyNote: To reduce spam, I don't list my primary day-to-day contacts here. The public channels shown above can still reach me—thanks for your understanding.

directions.title: Directions
directions.subtitle: These are the technical directions I have dabbled in, accumulated experience with, or am currently exploring:

full-stack.title: AI Full Stack Engineer
full-stack.summary: An AI-era full stack engineer integrating requirements analysis, architecture design, development, review, and testing. Oriented towards user needs, truly creating value rather than just self-entertainment.

cloud-computing.title: Cloud Computing
cloud-computing.summary: The infrastructure for modern software development and deployment. This is also the original direction of my project team, where I have built some expertise. Applying traditional technologies like Kubernetes to next-generation platforms to provide high-quality user experiences.

ai-infra.title: AI Infra
ai-infra.summary: The new direction for our project team in the AI era, primarily focusing on the layers between accelerator kernel functions and training/inference frameworks. I have done some work on predicting hardware resource usage for tasks, and I am highly interested in and familiar with low-level operator analysis and optimization.

agent.title: Agent
agent.summary: Building agent systems equipped with memory, tools, knowledge bases, and autonomous action capabilities to automate complex tasks. I am interested and familiar with the concepts, and many people around me are working on this, but I haven't put it into practice myself yet.

startup.title: Startup
startup.summary: You can't always just follow others; you need to have something you want to build yourself. However, I haven't started yet and am looking forward to meeting like-minded friends.

finance-quant.title: Finance & Quant
finance-quant.summary: I am equally interested in this but haven't started yet; looking forward to meeting like-minded friends.

creative-design.title: Creative Design
creative-design.summary: Since high school, I have loved tinkering with software like PS and AE to create posters and videos, and I still mess around with them from time to time.
